title: Nested smart cutoff comparison: strict endpoints
statement:
Let C be an abelian category and L a nonnegative cochain complex. For integers a < b, let g be a map of the indicated cutoffs compatible with their inclusions into the reextended L, and let q satisfy the canonical projection equation below. Then q is a quasi-isomorphism.
theorem verticalCutoff_column_quasiIso_strict
    (L : CochainComplex C ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a < b)
    (g : (verticalCutoff a).obj L ⟶ (verticalCutoff b).obj L)
    (hg : g ≫ (verticalCutoffι b).app L = (verticalCutoffι a).app L)
    (q : cokernel g ⟶ (verticalWindow a b).obj L)
    (hq : cokernel.π g ≫ q = HomologicalComplex.restrictionMap
      (CochainComplex.truncLEMap
        (CochainComplex.πTruncGE (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) a) (b - 1))
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) : QuasiIso q
